en.headline: Mooncakes: just a small slice
body: Share one mooncake with your family.
Have a thin slice with plain tea.
Plain tea is better than a sweet drink.
en.passage: share a mooncake, have a small slice with plain tea instead of sweet drinks

ms.headline: Kuih bulan, sedikit sahaja
body: Kongsi sebiji kuih bulan dengan keluarga anda.
Makan sepotong nipis dengan teh kosong.
Teh kosong lebih baik daripada air manis.
ms.passage: share a mooncake, have a small slice with plain tea instead of sweet drinks
